question: How did the tracked fields of this record change over time?

steps.name: changes
steps.soql: SELECT Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate FROM {history} WHERE {parent} = '{id}' ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

traps: Only tracked fields appear, from the day tracking was switched on.
Standard objects: <Object>History with <Object>Id. Custom objects: <Object>__History with ParentId.
